text:
vivian: quick question for the group  i've tightened action spacing inside the activity card for the console (prototype linked). thinking `--space-2` between inline actions but keeping container padding at `--space-3`. need a11y + eng signoff before token PR.

raj: short and sweet please: does this change affect icon-only buttons vs labeled buttons differently? touch target concerns?

marta: yes — icon-only should remain 44x44. labeled buttons can use reduced horizontal padding but keep min-width 80px to avoid wrap. we should offer a `--button-compact` variant rather than changing default button metrics.

vivian: sample CSS for docs page:```css
.action-row { display:flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items:center; }
.btn--compact { padding: 0 calc(var(--space-2) - 2px); min-width:80px; height:44px; }
.btn--icon { width:44px; height:44px; }
```

joel: accessibility: preserve DOM order; don't use `order` to change logical tab order. when actions wrap, primary must stay first in DOM and receive focus first. add keyboard tests for wrap scenarios.

a11y-bot: checklist: focus ring contrast (use `--color-focus-strong`), outline-offset 3px, ensure :focus-visible only for keyboard. include screen reader test for toast announce behavior.

vivian: toasts: current app places them bottom-right which collides with right-rail CTAs. proposal: top-right on desktop, center-bottom on mobile. newest on top, max 3, auto-dismiss 6s info / 12s warn / sticky error. `aria-live: polite` for info, `role=alert` for errors.

raj: related: when a toast appears above a control that has focus, ensure focus isn't stolen. toast should not receive focus automatically; Esc should dismiss and focus returned to trigger.

marta: agree. implementation notes: toast container `pointer-events:none`, toast `pointer-events:auto`, and use `transform` for entrance to avoid relayout. honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. small token `--toast-gap: var(--space-2)` for stacked spacing.

vivian: copy nit: use `Dismiss` as the action verb on toasts (consistent with other UI). also sentence case for button labels.

joel: will add the keyboard and NVDA test cases to the a11y board. if tests pass, i'm fine with the token change and new `btn--compact` variant.

design-bot: preview: https://deploy-preview/redwood/1965001234-compact-actions  visual diffs + tokens included.

vivian: thanks all — i'll open the PR with the tokens and component docs, and include the accessibility checklist. :sparkles:
